ask.title: Passenger request
ask.gone: This request is no longer waiting for an answer: it lapsed or was already answered.

auth.accountSuspended: This account cannot be used. Write to us if you think that is wrong.
auth.homeTownHint: Where you usually set out from. We use it to work out which region you are in.
auth.phoneHint: We'll send you a verification code.
auth.profileTitle: Tell us a little about you
auth.signupExpired: That took too long. Ask for a new code and start again.
auth.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
auth.unknownPlace: I do not know that settlement. Pick one from the list.
auth.unreachable: Cannot reach the server at {{url}}. Is it running, and are you on the same network?
auth.birthDateHint: Needed to confirm you are an adult. It is never shown to anyone.
auth.underage: This app is for adults. You have to be 18.
auth.resent: We sent you a new code.

contribution.label: What about the fuel?
contribution.hint: You decide what you ask for. The app works out what the trip burns and will not let you ask for more than your share, because profit is not allowed.
contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.autoHint: The app works out the fuel share and suggests it to the passenger.
contribution.freeHint: No figure is suggested. Whatever the passenger gives is between the two of you.
contribution.less: I ask for less than my share

estimate.about: About {{amount}} for the fuel, not an offer from a driver.
estimate.basis: For {{km}} km, with a typical car and {{seats}} seats offered.
estimate.notAnOffer: This is not an offer of a trip. No driver has been found or agreed. The real contribution appears with the specific car and may differ.
estimate.upTo: With a thirstier car, up to {{amount}}.

garage.consumptionNotAsked: We do not ask how much it drinks. We work it out from the car, which is what keeps the contribution below cost.
garage.empty: You have not said what you drive yet.
garage.hint: One car is enough. Add a second only if you really drive one, and pick which you are taking on each trip.
garage.inUse: A route you have published still uses this car. Take the route down first.
garage.label: What you call it
garage.notACar: I cannot work out a consumption for this car. Check the engine size and the fuel.
garage.title: My cars
garage.tooMany: That is as many cars as one account may keep.
garage.engineCCHint: Field P.1 on the registration document. Without it there is no consumption to work out.

home.title: Your trips
home.againNone: No next trip with a free seat
home.requestNobody: No driver has been asked yet.
home.requestNoDrivers: Nobody has published this road yet. Your request stays open. As soon as somebody does, we ask them, and you will see it here.
home.requestAsking: A driver is being asked right now.
home.requestExhausted: Every driver on this road said no or did not answer. The request stays open. If somebody publishes a new route, we will ask them too.
home.requestDeclined_one: {{count}} driver said no or did not answer.
home.requestDeclined_other: {{count}} drivers said no or did not answer.
home.suggestionHint: Tap one to ask for a seat again.
home.emptyBody: Shared journeys with people from your area who already go that way. Early on, somebody may not turn up straight away.
home.emptyOfferSeat: I have a seat in my car
home.requestStranded: Your driver cancelled. Your request stands and we are looking for another.
home.laterCount_one: And {{count}} more departure in the weeks after
home.laterCount_other: And {{count}} more departures in the weeks after

luggage.driverHint: We will not bother you about anything bigger.
luggage.hint: We will only offer you drivers who take it.
luggage.label: What are you bringing?
luggage.driverCountLabel: How many luggage places are left for passengers?
luggage.bootTotal: How many bags fit in total?
luggage.bootOwn: Of those, how many are yours?
luggage.bootNothingLeft: No room left for passengers. Choose “a bag at your feet” above.

map.unconfigured: No map is configured on this deployment.

phone.codeHint: Enter the code that arrived on the new number.
phone.hint: We will text a code to the new number.
phone.signsOutOthers: This signs you out on your other devices.
phone.title: Change number

places.noMeetingPoints: No meeting point is listed here. Agree one between yourselves.
places.hereFailed: Could not tell where you are. Type the town.
places.proposeDuplicate: There is already a point there.
places.proposeHint: Somebody will look at it before anyone else sees it.
places.proposeOpen: Know a better spot? Suggest it
places.proposeSent: Got it. It will appear once somebody has looked at it.
places.proposeTapTheMap: Tap the map to show exactly where.
places.proposeTooFar: That point is not in this area.
places.proposeTooMany: That is enough suggestions for today.

preferences.bioPlaceholder: e.g. I work in Alexandroupoli and drive down Tuesdays and Thursdays.
preferences.hint: These are not rules, they are what to expect.
preferences.title: What your rides are like

price.consumptionIsAFloor: The consumption is an approximation for the car's class.
price.dividedBy: Divided by {{divisor}} (every seat and the driver)

mode.free_contribution: Give what you think is right.

price.nationalFuelPrice: The fuel price is the national figure, not this region's.
price.notAFare: This is a contribution to the cost, not a fare. The driver always recovers less than they spend.
price.waived: The driver asks for nothing on a trip this short.

profile.bioTooLong: That is longer than a profile takes. Keep it short.
profile.name: Name
profile.noRoutes: You have not published any routes
profile.photoFailed: Your photos could not be opened.
profile.photoInvalid: That is not a JPEG or PNG
profile.retireConfirm: This route will no longer be offered, and its scheduled trips are called off.
profile.retireWithTrips: This route will no longer be offered, and its empty trips are called off. {{count}} with passengers stay: cancel those one by one if you need to, so they are told.
profile.socialHint: Just the username, not the whole link. Not verified.
profile.socialInvalid: Give a facebook.com or instagram.com link
profile.title: Your profile
profile.bioHasContactDetails: Take the contact details out of your profile. Everybody can see it, not only whoever travels with you, and your passenger can reach you through the app.

publish.replacing: You are changing {{route}}. When you publish, the old one is retired and its empty trips are called off.
publish.replaceFailed: The new route is out, but the old one was not retired. Retire it from your routes.
publish.detourChange: Change it just for this trip
publish.detourHint: Extra kilometres over your own journey. There is a time limit too, because 15 km on the motorway is not 15 km on a mountain road.
publish.outsideServiceArea: That destination is outside the area we can route to yet. Try somewhere closer.
publish.noStopsHint: You will not be offered anyone who is not already on your route.
publish.title: Publish a route
publish.noDriverProfile: Add your car in your profile first, then publish the route.
publish.noCar: You have not said what you drive yet.
publish.bootFullHint: Your own luggage fills the boot. Pick “None” for luggage to publish with no space, or leave one place free.
publish.leavingNowHint: A trip for the next quarter of an hour. Once published it opens, so you can say exactly when you leave.

request.alreadyMatched: A driver took your ride, so the request was not cancelled. If you can no longer go, cancel the booking from the trip.
request.title: Your request
request.closed: This request is no longer open.
request.leaveOk: You can close the app. We will notify you as soon as a driver accepts.
request.strandedTitle: Your driver cancelled. You do not need to do anything: we are already asking the next one.
request.alternativesIntro: These cars still pass along your road and will be asked in this order:
request.noAlternatives: No other car on your road for now. The request stays open.
request.strandedNobody: Your driver cancelled. Your request stays open and we will ask any driver who appears on your road.
request.alternativesFailed: The other cars did not load.
request.leaveOkNoPush: The app does not send notifications yet. Open it again in a little while: this page updates itself as soon as a driver accepts.

search.noDrivers: No driver right now. We'll let you know.
search.title: Ask for a seat
search.whatHappens: We ask drivers heading that way, one at a time, and tell you as soon as somebody says yes. Nothing is charged.
search.supply: At least three drivers go this way that day
search.whatHappensNoPush: We ask drivers heading that way, one at a time. The answer shows here and on the home screen, so check back in a little while. Nothing is charged.
search.noDriversNoPush: No driver right now. The request stays open: check the home screen again later.

share.callToAction: Message me if you want a seat.
share.copied: Copied. Paste it into the chat.

trip.cancelWithPassengers: This trip will not happen. {{count}} passengers will be told.
trip.notCancellable: The trip has already set off
trip.notDeparted: You can confirm once the trip sets off
trip.repeatDeclined: The driver did not take it up
trip.socialSelfDeclared: Self-declared, we have not verified it
trip.title: Trip
trip.portTitle: The trip ends at the port
trip.portBody: The rest of the way is by boat. The ferry ticket is not part of the price and is arranged separately.
trip.leaveConfirm: Your seat goes back and {{name}} will be told.
trip.leaveGone: That seat is no longer yours
trip.sendFailed: The message was not sent. Press Send again.

user.title: Profile
user.reportDetailPlaceholder: What happened, in your own words
user.reportHint: A person reads every report. They will not be told it was you.
user.reportRateLimited: That is a lot of reports for one day. The ones you sent are being looked at.
user.blockHint: You will not be matched on a trip again. A trip you have already booked is not cancelled: do that from the trip itself.

groups.title: Groups
groups.intro: A group is the people you already know from school or work. On a trip you see who is in the same group as you, and you can publish a route for your group only. Admins can see the trips members confirmed with each other, so the organisation can support them.
groups.none: You are not in any group yet.
groups.shareMessage: Join the group “{{name}}” on carpool with the code {{code}}
groups.newCodeConfirm: The old code will stop working. Everyone already in stays in.
groups.badName: Write a name between 2 and 60 characters.
groups.badCode: That code does not open any group.
groups.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes today. Try again tomorrow.
groups.tooMany: You are already in as many groups as you can be.
groups.exportHint: Confirmed trips between members, for whoever pays for them.

live.title: Where you are
live.sharing: Your location is visible to your fellow travellers while this screen is open, until you press Stop.
live.over: The trip is over. Location is no longer shared.
live.nobody: Nobody is sharing their location right now.
live.denied: Without location permission your location cannot be shared.
live.who: Only the driver and their passengers see it. Passengers do not see each other.
live.sendFailed: Your location is not being sent. Check your connection.
live.stopFailed: Your location was not removed. Try again.

sharedRoute.title: Route
sharedRoute.notFound: This link does not lead to a route.
sharedRoute.retired: This route is no longer offered.
sharedRoute.forGroup: Offered to the members of one group only.
sharedRoute.howItWorks: The driver shares costs, they do not sell rides. Search the road and the app will ask them for you.
sharedRoute.join: Create an account to ask for a seat

errors.invalid_seats: Seats must be 1 to 8 in a car, and up to 4 in a request.
errors.oneoff_in_past: That time has already passed. Pick a future date or time.
errors.oneoff_too_far: A one-off route can be published up to three weeks ahead.
errors.invalid_window: The latest departure must be after the earliest, on the same day. Trips across midnight are not supported.
errors.too_short: Start and destination are the same place. A trip must be at least a kilometre.
errors.window_in_past: That time has already passed. Pick a future time.
errors.window_too_far: A request can look up to three weeks ahead.
errors.already_aboard: This passenger already has a seat on this trip.
errors.invalid_name: That name cannot be used. Write your name in letters, up to 80 characters.
errors.women_only_needs_female: Women drivers only is a setting for women. Set your gender first.
errors.rate_limited: Too many at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.outside_country: That point is outside Greece. The app only works for journeys within the country.
errors.bad_departure: Pick a time within the next quarter of an hour.
errors.outside_window: That time is too far from the route's published time.
errors.drive_departed: You have already left. The time can no longer change.
errors.trip_not_running: This trip has been called off.
errors.bad_detour: The detour must be 0 to 30 minutes.
errors.not_driving: That drive is not under way.

shareRequest.callToAction: If you're going, send me a message.
shareRequest.hint: Someone you know may drive this road and not have the app yet.

settings.genderHint: Optional. Nobody else sees it; it is only needed for women drivers only.
settings.womenOnlyHint: You will only be matched with cars a woman is driving.
settings.womenOnlyNeedsGender: This is a setting for women. Choose a gender above first.
settings.asksPausedOff: Away for a while? Pause here. Your routes stay as they are.
settings.asksPausedOn: Nobody will ask you for a seat until you turn this off. Your routes stay as they are.

drive.title: Leaving? Say when
drive.detour: How far off your road for a passenger (0′: your road only)
drive.hint: We only ask people who will be at the road before you pass. You never wait.
drive.pickupAt: The driver reaches your pickup around {{time}}
drive.nudge: Tell me when somebody on my road is waiting
drive.nudgeHint: Shortly before you leave, if you have a free seat.
drive.trackBody: For this drive only, until you tap «End».
drive.trackDenied: Without your position we cannot tell anyone when you pass, so no passengers are sent to you while you drive.
drive.hereDone: The driver knows you are at the pickup.
drive.bookedFrom: With passengers booked you can leave from {{time}} on, as agreed.
drive.carShared: Your car's position is shared with your passengers, for this drive only and until you tap «End».

detect.prompt: Looks like you are driving. Say when you leave and we ask the people waiting on your road.
detect.hint: Only near your departure times, and only on your phone: where you are is not sent anywhere.
detect.denied: Without the activity permission the phone cannot tell when you are in a car.
detect.notifyBody: Say when you leave and we ask the people waiting on your road.
detect.shortcutSteps: Shortcuts → Automation → + → Driving Focus (or CarPlay) → When turning on → Run immediately → Open URL: carpool://driving
detect.none: You have no trip near this time.
